basis.description: What they are prepared under, once approved.
examples: Prepared under SFRS for Small Entities (2nd edition)

blocks.description: The statement, block by block in order.

checks.description: Its checks (INV-10): the balance sheet and trial balance balance, and every balance-sheet account sits in a section.

columns.description: The columns, in order: the run, then its comparative; or a month each, then for a P&L the total.

currency.description: The base currency every amount is in.

kind.description: pl: the profit and loss; bs: the balance sheet; tb: the trial balance.

ledger_revision.description: The ledger revision every figure is read as at (ENG-46): asking again as at it gives the same figures.

platform_version.description: The platform version that laid it out (REL-05).

restated_presentation.description: true when an account was created or changed after the revision, so the names and groups are today's, not those in force at it (rev 0.159).

statement_title.description: How the financial year's statements are titled: management statements until its framework and policies are approved (FR-ORG-10).
